en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l67.c16/text: After a long and storied career serving the US government, it seems retirement is in store for you. It's unlikely you will get renominated if you try, anyways. Bob Dole will most likely be the next nominee for the presidency. Your son Jeb looks to be interested in politics, perhaps HE could be president one day.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l70.c20/text: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will likely overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. Conservativism still has a market, however,  in the American population, as it was a fairly close election. Unfortunately, it was likely your lack of independence from Reagan that caused it. Perhaps a more assertive candidate could run in 4 years?
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l73.c20/text: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. You, Let’s unfortunately, were not able to capitalize on the many political mistakes of Dukakis's career, and Republicans are disappointed that they couldn't keep the White House.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l76.c20/text: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. Many are shocked you lost by such a large margin and are calling into question if you were even fit for the vice presidency in the first place, or just road the wave of Reagan popularity  .
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l79.c33/text: Exactly 100 years after the previous instance of this, the popular vote loser has won the election!. Republicans aren't happy at all, and you can be sure they’re already thinking about 1992.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l84.c16/text: While most people are expecting a third term of Reagan, you know you didn't get elected solely on that idea. Your economic policy won't change for the most part, but you might be able to cool tensions a bit with the USSR, as that was one of the worries Americans had with Reagan. If all goes well, then you can be re-elected, and be the first president-vice president duo to be elected to 2 full terms each.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l87.c20/text: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. Your margin is certainly impressive, as many thought it would be a closer election due to 2 terms of Republicans.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l90.c20/text: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. You didn't do as well as Reagan, however, you still have won by a decent margin, so let’s hope you can work with the Democrats to engineer some bipartisanship legislature.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l93.c20/text: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. The election was quite close, as many predicted, so let’s  hope the good economy and suffering the USSR can carry you through to the midterms.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l96.c33/text: For the first time since 1888, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! This has many Democrats are very angry, and they are lamenting the Bayh-Celler amendment not passing.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l104.c16/tex: You are still governor of Massachusetts, and your term expires in 91. it's up to you whether or not you seek a 4th term, but ultimately federal politics seems no longer the choice for you. Let’s hope the more moderate Bush can end the cold war once and for all, and keep America prosperous.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l107.c20/tex: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Likely due to the moderate opinions of Bush, and the close election will force him to govern across party lines.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l110.c20/tex: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Many are shocked at Bush's comeback, seeing as you were the favourite early on. Reagan's popularity was just too much for you to deal with.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l113.c20/tex: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Many are shocked at your massive loss, as you weren't even favoured to lose in the first place. Most people think you should have stuck up for yourself more, and not ignore the attacks Bush made.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l116.c31/tex: You are still governor of Massachusetts, and your term expires in 91. Perhaps due to you winning the popular vote, a run in 4 years is in the cards.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l121.c16/tex: The tax cuts for the rich will certainly be scaled back under your administration, as well as you will reduce military spending. With all this new money, perhaps social security can be expanded. Just watch the deficit, and you could get re-elected if you follow through with your competent persona.
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l124.c20/tex: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. And what a win it is! The house and Senate are solidly in your hands, so you should have little trouble passing your legislation
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l127.c20/tex: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. Democrats are still reeling a bit from the Reagan Revolution, so the win isn't as big as you'd like, but a win is a win after 8 years of Reagan, no?
en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l130.c20/tex: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. en.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l133.c33/tex: You best be cautious, however, as the popular vote was won by Bush instead of you. So act quick or the midterms with be swift and brutal.

zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l65.c27/text: 很遗憾，你输掉了1988年选举。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l67.c16/text: 你为美国政府服务多年，经历丰富，如今似乎该退休了。反正即便尝试，你也很难再获提名。鲍勃·多尔很可能成为下一个总统候选人。你的儿子杰布似乎对政治有兴趣，也许有朝一日当总统的是他呢。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l70.c20/text: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯很可能撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。不过，这场选举相当接近，说明保守主义在美国民众中仍有市场。遗憾的是，败选很可能是因为你未能展现出足够独立于里根的形象。也许四年后可以让一位更有主见的候选人出马？
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l73.c20/text: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯将撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。遗憾的是，你未能利用杜卡基斯政治生涯中的诸多失误，共和党人对没能保住白宫感到失望。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l76.c20/text: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯将撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。许多人震惊于你输得如此惨重，开始怀疑你当初是否有资格担任副总统，还是只是搭上了里根受欢迎的顺风车。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l79.c33/text: 距离上次恰好一百年，普选票落败者又一次赢得了总统选举！共和党人很不高兴，而且可以肯定，他们已经在盘算1992年了。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l84.c16/text: 虽然大多数人期待的是“里根的第三届任期”，你知道自己并不只是靠这个主张当选。你的经济政策基本不会变，但也许可以稍稍缓和与苏联的紧张关系——这正是美国人对里根的一项担忧。如果一切顺利，你就能连任，成为首对先后各自当选两届完整任期的总统与副总统搭档。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l87.c20/text: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。你的优势确实惊人，许多人原本认为，共和党已经执政两届，这次选举会更加接近。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l90.c20/text: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。你虽然不及里根的战绩，但优势依然可观，希望你能与民主党合作，促成两党共同支持的立法。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l93.c20/text: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。正如许多人预测的那样，选举十分接近；希望良好的经济形势与苏联的困境能帮你撑过中期选举。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l96.c33/text: 自1888年以来，普选票落败者首次赢得了总统选举！许多民主党人对此非常愤怒，痛惜贝赫—塞勒修正案未能通过。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l102.c27/tex: 很遗憾，你输掉了1988年选举。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l104.c16/tex: 你仍是马萨诸塞州州长，任期将在1991年结束。是否争取第四届任期由你决定，但联邦政治似乎终究不再适合你。希望更加温和的布什能彻底结束冷战，让美国保持繁荣。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l107.c20/tex: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。布什的温和观点，加上接近的选举结果，很可能会迫使他跨越党派界线执政。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l110.c20/tex: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。你早期最被看好，因此许多人对布什的逆转感到震惊。里根的人气实在令你无从应对。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l113.c20/tex: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。你原本甚至不被看作会输的人，因此许多人震惊于这场惨败。大多数人认为，你本该更多为自己辩护，而非无视布什的攻击。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l116.c31/tex: 你仍是马萨诸塞州州长，任期将在1991年结束。也许因为你赢得了普选票，四年后再次参选仍有可能。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l121.c16/tex: 你的政府肯定会缩减对富人的减税，也会减少军费开支。有了这笔新增资金，也许可以扩大社会保障。只要注意赤字，并兑现自己能干的形象，你就可能获得连任。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l124.c20/tex: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。而且这是一场多么漂亮的胜利！众议院和参议院都牢牢掌握在你方手中，推动立法应该不会遇到太大困难。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l127.c20/tex: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。民主党人尚未完全从“里根革命”的冲击中缓过来，因此优势不如你期望的那么大；不过里根执政八年后，能赢总归是赢，对吧？
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l130.c20/tex: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。这次胜利表明，保守主义在公众心中仍占有一席之地，因此要做好准备，持续面对国会两院中的反对者。
zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/ending/s0.l133.c33/tex: 不过，你最好谨慎些，因为普选票赢家是布什，而非你。所以要尽快行动，否则中期选举会迅速而残酷地惩罚你。

zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/answers_json/4420@11/d: 我们主张惠及全体美国人的自由主义。布什认同里根制造分裂、赢家通吃的经济政策，正是这些政策让中产阶级变得更穷。

zh.1988_Dukakis_Gore/answers_json/4425@16/d: 我没有什么要隐瞒的。我很自豪，能捍卫每个美国人都应享有的良心自由。
